title: The Substitution — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational soccer philosophy 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Spanish French language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The substitution board goes up and shows a number that is yours
And you've been on the pitch for sixty-seven minutes of the cause
The manager has decided that the seventy-first minute needs new energy
And the energy is currently sitting on the bench with strategy

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El tablero de sustitución muestra tu número al fin
[The substitution board shows your number at last]
Sesenta y siete minutos de entrega — ese es tu adn
[Sixty-seven minutes of commitment — that is your DNA]
El entrenador decide que el momento setenta y uno necesita más
[The manager decides that minute seventy-one needs more]
La energía está en el banco, lista para el compás
[The energy is on the bench, ready for the beat]

[Chorus — English]
The substitution knows something I don't know
It knows the exact moment when a fresh pair of legs should go
The substitution is a conversation that was had at half time
About the state of the second half — the call, the sign
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le panneau de remplacement se lève avec ton numéro
[The substitution board rises with your number]
Tu as donné tout ce que tu avais — zéro regret, zéro
[You gave everything you had — zero regret, zero]
Le remplaçant court vers le terrain avec de nouvelles jambes
[The substitute runs onto the pitch with fresh legs]
Et tu sors en sachant que tu as fait ta part — cette gambe
[And you leave knowing you played your part — this leg]

[Outro — All three languages]
Substitution knows… La sustitución sabe… Le remplacement sait
Fresh legs, final third — Piernas frescas, tercio final — Jambes fraîches, dernier tiers
That's my boy
